verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents programmatic API access through service accounts, but nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a published deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. Versioned APIs are a fair axis for an observability platform with an API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
